=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/protected_path_authorization.py:119-130, 344-363 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: `_disable_auto_merge` discards the GraphQL response, and `_gh_json` does not detect top-level `errors`, so `check_pr` can report auto-merge disabled when the mutation failed.
  WHY: A failed mutation can leave auto-merge enabled on a refused protected PR, defeating the authorization gate; severity disagreement: some reviewers rated this MAJOR, while the highest rating was BLOCKER.
- scripts/protected_path_authorization.py:346-363 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `_disable_auto_merge` makes a single mutation attempt and does not retry transient GraphQL or transport failures.
  WHY: A transient failure can leave auto-merge enabled on a refused protected PR, potentially allowing it to merge later if no subsequent gate run retries the disable.
- scripts/protected_path_gate.sh:90-103, 122-131 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The cached decision can be bound to a stale checked head if the PR is updated between the cached check and a later merge.
  WHY: A concurrent push can make the cached head outdated, causing the wrapper to bind the merge to the pre-push head and skip another disable attempt for that cache key.
- scripts/protected_path_gate.sh:110, 114 | severity=low | confidence=[2]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The gate extracts and logs `.auto_merge` on every refusal, even when `--disable-auto-merge` was not requested.
  WHY: This adds a repeated `jq` parse and longer log lines for callers that do not use the disable feature, though the impact is marginal.

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/protected_path_authorization.py:362-363 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: `_disable_auto_merge` calls `_gh_json` and discards its return value, treating the GraphQL mutation as successful even if it fails with top-level `errors` in the HTTP 200 response.
  WHY: The gate reports `auto_merge` as disabled even when the mutation failed to turn it off, potentially allowing a later merge using an auto-merge setting enabled on an earlier, unprotected head.
- scripts/protected_path_authorization.py:346-363 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: `_disable_auto_merge` does not retry on transient GraphQL or transport failures.
  WHY: A transient failure during the disable mutation leaves auto-merge enabled on an unauthorized PR, potentially allowing a merge that should have been blocked.
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/protected_path_authorization.py:119-130, 362-363 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: `_gh_json` does not inspect top-level GraphQL `errors`, and `_disable_auto_merge` discards the response, so `check_pr` can report auto-merge disabled after the mutation failed.
  WHY: The JSON output and wrapper log can report a successful disable while auto-merge remains pending, allowing an unauthorized protected change to land.
- scripts/protected_path_authorization.py:363 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: `_disable_auto_merge` issues one `gh api graphql` call with no retry.
  WHY: An HTTP 502 on the first call leaves auto-merge enabled on a refused protected PR.
- scripts/protected_path_authorization.py:338-349, 119-130 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: `check_pr` trusts `disable(node_id)` not raising to conclude that the GraphQL mutation succeeded, although `_gh_json` does not raise on a top-level `errors` array.
  WHY: The JSON decision and `auto_merge=disabled` log line can falsely report success, leaving the failure undetectable without an extra GitHub API read.
- scripts/protected_path_gate.sh:90-103, 122-131 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  PROBLEM: The cached checker decision can be reused after a PR update, binding a merge to the pre-push head and preventing a disable retry for the same cache key.
  WHY: Routine pushes can make the cached head stale, so the wrapper can fail a merge bound to that earlier head.
- scripts/protected_path_authorization.py:357-363 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: The GraphQL mutation does not request fields that confirm whether the mutation took effect.
  WHY: With errors swallowed, the caller cannot distinguish an empty response from a successful mutation.
- scripts/protected_path_gate.sh:110, 114 | severity=low | confidence=[2]
  PROBLEM: The gate extracts `.auto_merge` and writes it into the block-decision log on every call, even when `--disable-auto-merge` was not requested.
  WHY: The repeated parse and longer log line have only marginal impact, and the change is not load-bearing.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
